population_definition.inclusion: first positive-price commercial game published during stated release cohort window, whether or not any buyer paid
exclude: seller account without published eligible paid game

authorized_data_sources.scope: own project page views downloads purchases and receipts
account-scoped documented endpoints only; sales access must be independently confirmed for each endpoint
visible game release, featured and sale listings, not confidential sales

data_collection_policy: No account login, password, API token, checkout identity, email, IP address or unique buyer ID may be stored in this public research protocol.
Store summary counts by consented cohort and project, not player- or developer-identifying records.
Do not send or publish aggregate cells that permit reidentification.
Never infer platform-wide sales if coverage or inclusion of zero earners is incomplete.
Do not equate order/page-view rate with unique customer conversion, causal effect or first-time seller success probability.
acceptance_for_representative_income: Defined sampling frame of eligible first-release paid game publishers including zero-sale and inactive titles.
Known inclusion probabilities or defensible complete-census design; otherwise label a convenience sample.
Comparable observation windows, current-currency amounts and fee/refund deductions.
Separate account, game, developer, team and person denominators.
Owner-authorized anonymous aggregate evidence with public redistribution clearance.
